title: Thinking Outside the Box in Making Cryo-EM More Accessible for Everyone
content:
Abstract
The iterative nature of grid screening for single-particle analysis often requires a microscope that efficiently bridges the gap between sample preparation and high-resolution data collection. However, such a system is often specialized solely for cryogenic applications and may present substantial financial barriers. Enhancing the versatility of a thermionic TEM to support both room-temperature and cryogenic-temperature applications can provide more laboratories with greater accessibility to cryo-electron microscopy equipment. Through the experimental evaluations of Hitachi’s innovative retractable cold finger design, coupled with Simple Origin’s transfer holder and SerialEM, Hitachi’s HT7800 TEM was shown to be an effective screening tool in multiple environments.
